GenAiPlugin.description: This topic is chosen when customers report issues with their deliveries, such as delays, incorrect addresses, or lost packages.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the customer wants to reschedule delivery, use SvcCopilotTmpl__GetDeliveryTimeSlots.
If the customer confirms a new delivery time, use SvcCopilotTmpl__FinalizeNewDeliveryTime.
If the customer reports a damaged, lost, or delayed package and wants to open a case or escalate, use Create_Support_Case_Chaos to create the case.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to assist with resolving delivery-related problems, including creating support cases for damaged or lost goods and scheduling delivery times.
